Run the Tunnel Control Plane and supervised frps process

Usage:
  ycy tunnel server [flags]

Flags:
      --address string              Address for all tunnel server listeners
      --advertise-frp-addr string   FRP endpoint advertised to trusted clients
      --control-port string         Tunnel Control Plane port
      --data-dir string             Tunnel server state directory
      --frp-port string             FRP bind port
  -h, --help                        help for server
      --http-port string            FRP HTTP vhost port
      --port-range string           Server Port Pool
      --session-idle-days string    Session idle lifetime in days

Global Flags:
      --log-format string   Diagnostic format: text or json
      --log-level string    Log level: debug, info, warn, or error
      --quiet               Only emit error diagnostics (short form: -q)
  -v, --verbose             Enable debug diagnostics
